offering_description.value: TXNM Energy is a holding company that owns regulated electric utilities PNM in New Mexico and TNMP in Texas. It generates, buys, transmits and distributes electricity to residential, commercial, industrial and wholesale customers, delivering power over its own grid.

primary_services.value: electric transmission; electric distribution; electricity generation and supply; retail electric service

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electricity customers in New Mexico and Texas; B2B: commercial, industrial and wholesale customers, retail electricity providers in Texas; B2G: public authorities and municipal customers

end_markets.value: residential power; commercial and industrial power; wholesale electricity; utilities

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated rates for electricity delivery and supply; transaction or usage fees: volumetric charges and transmission tariffs paid by retail providers and wholesale customers
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs generation plants, transmission and distribution networks, selling power and delivery to end users

geography_served.value: US regional: New Mexico (PNM) and Texas (TNMP) service territories

specialization.value: related lines: vertically integrated electric utility in New Mexico plus transmission and distribution utility in Texas

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: regulated utility service delivered directly through its grid to customers; other: retail electricity providers in Texas that bill end customers using TNMP's delivery network

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utilities overseen by NM Public Regulation Commission, Texas PUC, FERC, and environmental rules

notes: TXNM was subject to a pending acquisition by Blackstone Infrastructure; status uncertain.
